findings.evidence: `rg -n "cauchyPV.*zero|\[simp\]" code/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/CauchyPrincipalValueOn.lean code/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/CauchyPrincipalValue.lean` finds the pointwise `@[simp] theorem cauchyPVAt_zero` at `CauchyPrincipalValue.lean:226-229`, while the set-level file only has `HasCauchyPV.zero` at `CauchyPrincipalValueOn.lean:178` and `cauchyPV`/`HasCauchyPV.cauchyPV_eq` at `441`/`447`.
findings.fix: Add the set-level analogue of `cauchyPVAt_zero`, e.g. `@[simp] theorem cauchyPV_zero ... : cauchyPV γ a b (fun _ => 0) = 0 := HasCauchyPV.zero.cauchyPV_eq`.
findings.issue: `cauchyPV` is public, but the zero normal form has no public `@[simp]` theorem, so `simp` cannot reduce `cauchyPV γ a b (fun _ => 0)` even though `HasCauchyPV.zero` and `HasCauchyPV.cauchyPV_eq` determine it.

summary: The value/uniqueness interface from the prior review is now present, but the new canonical value is missing the normal-form simp lemma that the pointwise API already provides.
